attchmntText: ATN International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: ATN International Limited announced the Board approved Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from statutory auditors M/s. Deoki Bijay & Co. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net loss after tax of 24.37 lakhs. Revenue from operations was 14.23 lakhs. Other income stood at 9.64 lakhs. Total expenditure was 34.00 lakhs. The loss before tax was 24.37 lakhs. Earnings per equity share was negative 0.06 rupees. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 161.21 lakhs. Equity share capital remains 1,578.00 lakhs. The financial results are available on the company website and stock exchanges.
